description:
The planning controls on this block: its zone (name, category, and in NSW
the statutory code) and, in NSW only, the height of buildings and floor
space ratio (FSR) limits at its address point. Zones are held for every
state and the ACT.

Hazard overlays are under `risks/all`.
Development applications in the surrounding area are a suburb-level call.

**Price: 8¢ per call.**
